name: American University of Vietnam
description: The American University of Vietnam (AUV) is a four-year degree-granting institution offering American-style higher education in Da Nang City, Vietnam. Founded in 2011, it provides a liberal arts education with a curriculum based on the American model, aiming to prepare students for advanced studies or careers in the US and globally.
campus_student_life: AUV's campus is located in Da Nang City, overlooking the sea and is a short walk from the beach. The campus features academic buildings, a student center, an international library, modern computer labs, and SMART board classrooms. Student life is supported by the Student Government Association (SGA), which organizes events and advocates for student needs.

name: An Giang University
description: An Giang University is a public higher education institution established in 1999 in Long Xuyen City, An Giang Province, Vietnam. It is a multidisciplinary university focusing on fields relevant to the Mekong Delta's economy and environment, such as agriculture, economics, education, and technology. The university is affiliated with Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City.
campus_student_life: The university has a rural campus located in Long Xuyen City and features facilities including a library, laboratories, and on-campus dormitories that can accommodate over 1620 students. An Giang University also hosts various student organizations and clubs, and an electronic newspaper is produced by and for the student body.

name: Arts University Bournemouth
description: Arts University Bournemouth (AUB) is a public university in Poole, England, specializing in art, architecture, film, performance, and design. Established in 1880, it is known for its creative focus and strong industry connections. AUB has been recognized for its teaching quality and research excellence.
campus_student_life: AUB's award-winning campus is located between Bournemouth and Poole, offering a creative environment with industry-standard facilities, studios, and an on-site gallery. Students can engage in over 30 clubs and societies run by the Students' Union. Accommodation is available on campus and in Bournemouth town centre.

name: British University Vietnam
description: British University Vietnam (BUV) is a private international university established in 2009, with its main campus located in Ecopark, Hung Yen, Vietnam. It is recognized as the first university in Vietnam to offer full British degrees and is the first QS 5-star university in Vietnam.
campus_student_life: The main Ecopark Campus is a 6.5-hectare site, with Phase 1 completed in 2018 and Phase 2 completed in 2025, capable of accommodating up to 5,500 students. Facilities include specialized teaching areas, a primary library, academic support offices, labs, creative studios, learning kitchens, gyms, a sports complex, and a football pitch. Student life is supported by over 30 student clubs and societies, and premium student accommodation is available at Swanlake Residences R2, located 2km from campus.

name: Can Tho University
description: Can Tho University is a public research university established in 1966 and is a multidisciplinary institution located in Can Tho, Vietnam. It is recognized as a leading university in the Mekong Delta region and is known for its agricultural research. The university aims to be a leading higher education institution in Vietnam and a recognized top university in the Asia-Pacific region for training and research.
campus_student_life: Can Tho University has an urban campus in Can Tho city, with a branch campus in Hau Giang. The university provides various academic and non-academic facilities and services, including a library, housing, sports facilities, and financial aid. Dormitories are available with a capacity for 8,780 students, offering amenities like internet, canteens, and recreational areas. The campus life is enriched by intercultural activities due to the presence of both local and international students.

name: Da Nang University of Economics
description: Da Nang University of Economics (DUE) is a public university in Da Nang, Vietnam, established in 1975 as the Faculty of Economics. It is a member institution of the University of Da Nang and is recognized as one of Vietnam's leading centers for economic education and research. The university specializes in economics, business administration, and related disciplines, offering undergraduate, master's, and doctoral programs.
campus_student_life: The main campus is located at 71 Ngũ Hành Sơn Street in Da Nang. The university provides facilities to support student development, including dormitories and sports amenities. It aims to foster a humanistic and innovative academic environment.

name: Da Nang University of Science and Technology
description: Da Nang University of Science and Technology (DUT) is a prominent public university of technology in Vietnam, established in 1975 as a member of the University of Da Nang system. It is recognized as one of the most important technological institutions in the country, focusing on engineering and technology education and research. The university is located in Da Nang, Vietnam.
campus_student_life: The university is part of the University of Da Nang system and is located in Da Nang, Vietnam. Information regarding specific campus facilities, student organizations, or accommodation is not readily available in the provided search results, though general university life aspects are mentioned for the broader University of Da Nang.

name: Dalat University
description: Dalat University is a public, multidisciplinary higher education institution founded in 1957 in Dalat, Vietnam. It offers a wide range of undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral programs and is known for its focus on research relevant to the Central Highlands region. The university is recognized by the Ministry of Education and Training of Vietnam.
campus_student_life: The university campus is situated on a hilly area of 40 hectares, surrounded by pine trees and offering scenic views, providing a peaceful atmosphere for learning. It features various buildings, an electronic library, and a multipurpose sports center. Student life includes participation in academic, cultural, and sports clubs, as well as university-organized cultural events and workshops.

name: Dong Nai University
description: Dong Nai University is a public university located in Bien Hoa City, Dong Nai Province, Vietnam, established in 1976. It operates under the People's Committee of Dong Nai province and is supervised by the Ministry of Education and Training. The university offers undergraduate education to both domestic and international students, with a focus on contributing to regional development through education and training in various fields.
campus_student_life: The university's campus is located in an urban setting in Bien Hoa City. Dong Nai University provides academic support through resources like libraries and computer labs. It also fosters a dynamic campus life with various student organizations and activities, offering opportunities for students to engage with peers from diverse academic backgrounds.

name: Dong Thap University
description: Dong Thap University is a public, multidisciplinary university located in Cao Lãnh city, Đồng Tháp province, Vietnam. Established in 2003, it is a key institution for teacher education in the Mekong Delta region and offers a range of undergraduate and graduate programs. The university is known for its commitment to quality education and research, with a focus on contributing to the socio-economic development of the region.
campus_student_life: The university has a rural campus located in Cao Lãnh. It offers various facilities and services for students, including a library, and various centers for professional development and student support. Student life includes participation in clubs and organizations, such as the Summer Volunteer Student Campaign, and engagement in academic and cultural events.

name: Duy Tan University
description: Duy Tan University is a private, multidisciplinary research university located in Da Nang, Vietnam, founded on November 11, 1994. It is recognized as the first and largest private university in Central Vietnam and is known for its focus on applied sciences and technology, with a strong emphasis on international collaborations and partnerships.
campus_student_life: Duy Tan University operates across six campuses in Da Nang, with its largest campus covering over 33,977 square meters. The university provides a range of facilities including libraries, computer labs, and student accommodation. It fosters student engagement through various clubs and organizations, encouraging personal growth and leadership development.

name: Electric Power University
description: Electric Power University (EPU) is a public university in Hanoi, Vietnam, established in 2006. It is a leading institution for training and research in the power sector, providing high-quality human resources for Vietnam's energy industry. EPU is also recognized as a significant research center for science and technology within the energy field.
campus_student_life: EPU has campuses in Hanoi and Soc Son, Vietnam. The university offers training in 18 undergraduate and 7 graduate disciplines. It provides various training courses and is involved in scientific research and international cooperation. The university has a student body of approximately 10,000 students.

name: FPT University
description: FPT University is a private, for-profit university in Vietnam, founded in 2006. It is a member of the FPT Group and has multiple campuses across Vietnam, with its main campus in Hanoi. The university is known for its focus on Information Technology and Business Administration, with a strong emphasis on practical learning and industry connections.
financials: VND 25.3m-28.7m per semester ($1000-1200 per semester) ($4000-4800 per year)
campus_student_life: FPT University has multiple campuses in Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Can Tho, and Quy Nhon. The Hanoi campus, located in Hoa Lac Hi-Tech Park, features a canteen, restaurants, a library, and a sports center, with dormitories available. Other campuses also offer modern facilities, including well-equipped classrooms and laboratories. The university provides various academic and non-academic services, including a library, housing, sports facilities, and study abroad programs.

name: Foreign Trade University
description: Foreign Trade University (FTU) is a public university established in 1960, located in Hanoi, Vietnam, with satellite campuses in Ho Chi Minh City and Quang Ninh. It is recognized as one of Vietnam's most prestigious universities, known for its strong programs in economics, business administration, finance, banking, and foreign languages. FTU is highly selective, with a competitive admission process.
campus_student_life: FTU has campuses in Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, and Quang Ninh. The university provides various academic and non-academic facilities and services, including a library, housing, sports facilities, and opportunities for study abroad and exchange programs. Students can also participate in a range of extracurricular activities, from athletics to community service.

name: Fulbright University Vietnam
description: Fulbright University Vietnam is a private, nonprofit liberal arts university located in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Founded in 2016, it is one of Vietnam's first private, nonprofit institutions of higher education, offering undergraduate and graduate programs rooted in the American liberal arts tradition. The university is known for its focus on continuous innovation and addressing local and global challenges through its academic programs.
campus_student_life: Fulbright University Vietnam is developing its permanent campus in the Saigon Hi-Tech Park, with current facilities in District 7 of Ho Chi Minh City. Students live on-campus in residence dorms, sharing rooms. The university offers a variety of student clubs, including debate, theater, and badminton, and emphasizes student engagement through programs and events that foster holistic development.

name: Haiphong University
description: Haiphong University is a public university located in Haiphong, Vietnam. It was established in its current form in 2004, evolving from earlier educational institutions dating back to 1959. The university offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs across various disciplines.
campus_student_life: Haiphong University has three campuses, with the main campus in Kien An District covering 28 hectares and housing the administration, academic departments, lecture halls, a central library, and a student dormitory. Two additional campuses are located in Ngo Quyen District.

name: Hanoi Architectural University
description: Hanoi Architectural University is a non-profit public higher education institution located in Hanoi, Vietnam. Established in 1969, it is recognized as a leading university in architecture, urban planning, and civil engineering education and research in the country.
campus_student_life: The main campus of Hanoi Architectural University is situated on Nguyen Trai Street, Thanh Xuan District, Hanoi. The university provides academic and non-academic facilities including a library and sports facilities. It also offers study abroad and exchange programs for students.

name: Hanoi Medical University
description: Hanoi Medical University is a public institution located in Hanoi, Vietnam, founded in 1902 as the Indochina Medical College. It is recognized as Vietnam's oldest university and a leading institution for medical education, research, and healthcare training. The university is known for its rigorous academic standards and for producing highly qualified professionals for the health sector.
campus_student_life: The main campus of Hanoi Medical University is situated at No. 1 Ton That Tung Street, Dong Da District, Hanoi, spanning 146,686 square meters. It features 11 auditoriums, 53 classrooms, and two libraries. The university is closely integrated with Hanoi's healthcare ecosystem, with proximity to major teaching hospitals like Bach Mai Hospital, and offers student housing and sports facilities.

name: Hanoi National University of Education
description: Hanoi National University of Education (HNUE) is a public university in Hanoi, Vietnam, established in 1951. It is one of the largest higher education institutions in the country and is known for training high-quality teachers and conducting advanced scientific research, particularly in education science. HNUE plays a crucial role in shaping Vietnam's educational landscape.
campus_student_life: The university's main campus is located in the Cau Giay District of Hanoi and features modern classrooms, laboratories, and research facilities. HNUE has a comprehensive library system and invested in IT infrastructure. Student life includes various clubs for sports, arts, and culture, as well as opportunities for cultural exchange and excursions to historical sites. Dormitories are available for students, including international students.

name: Hanoi University
description: Hanoi University (HANU) is a public university established in 1959, initially focusing on foreign language training and research. It has since evolved into a multidisciplinary institution offering programs primarily taught in foreign languages, with a strong emphasis on linguistics, international studies, and business-related fields. The university is located in Hanoi, Vietnam.
campus_student_life: Hanoi University features a campus with buildings painted in different colors, a well-equipped outdoor sports field, and on-campus dormitories. The campus also includes the Hanoi Library, providing resources for students, and surrounding shops catering to student needs. Student life is enriched by various club activities, faculty events, and university-wide celebrations like the annual orientation and birthday celebration.

name: Hanoi University of Industry
description: Hanoi University of Industry (HaUI) is a public university founded in 1898, making it one of Vietnam's oldest technical institutions. It is a leading application-oriented university known for providing high-quality graduates to support the country's industrialization and modernization. HaUI offers a wide range of programs across multiple disciplines and education levels.
campus_student_life: HaUI has three campuses with a total area of nearly 50 hectares, equipped with modern facilities including lecture halls, computer labs, foreign language classrooms, workshops, gymnasiums, and sports fields. The university also features an e-library with a collection of approximately 400,000 titles and provides modern dormitory facilities, canteens, and healthcare services for students.

name: Hanoi University of Mining and Geology
description: Hanoi University of Mining and Geology (HUMG) was established in 1966 and is a public higher education institution in Hanoi, Vietnam. It specializes in training technical experts for the exploration and exploitation of natural resources, and is also a center for research and technology transfer in fields such as geology, petroleum, surveying, and mining. The university offers a range of programs including theoretical sciences, information technology, and business administration.
campus_student_life: HUMG has three campuses located in Hanoi, Quang Ninh, and Vung Tau. The main campus in Hanoi is equipped with modern facilities including classrooms, research centers, laboratories, and a library. The university fosters a vibrant student community with various clubs and extracurricular activities, and provides opportunities for hands-on training and research.

name: Hanoi University of Pharmacy
description: Hanoi University of Pharmacy (HUP) is a public higher education institution in Hanoi, Vietnam, specializing in pharmaceutical sciences, education, and research. Established in 1902, it is the country's only dedicated pharmacy university and plays a key role in Vietnam's healthcare sector. HUP offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs and is recognized for its contributions to pharmaceutical education and research.
campus_student_life: The main campus of Hanoi University of Pharmacy is located at 13-15 Le Thanh Tong Street in the Hoan Kiem District of Hanoi. The university provides a library and sports facilities for students. It also engages in international cooperation and exchange programs, hosting international students and sending its faculty abroad for further training.

name: Hanoi University of Public Health
description: Hanoi University of Public Health (HUPH) is a public university in Hanoi, Vietnam, established in 2001. It specializes in public health training and research, with a focus on epidemiology, health management, nutrition, and environmental health. HUPH is recognized for its contributions to Vietnam's public health workforce development and policy.
campus_student_life: HUPH has a single, well-equipped urban campus in Hanoi. The university offers a vibrant student life with various clubs, academic societies, and volunteer groups focused on health promotion. It also hosts annual cultural festivals and sporting events, and provides comprehensive student support services, including on-campus housing and recreational facilities.

name: Hanoi University of Science and Technology
description: Hanoi University of Science and Technology (HUST) is the first and largest technical university in Vietnam, established in 1956. It is a multidisciplinary institution known for its research-oriented approach and strong ties with industry, offering a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs in STEM fields. HUST has been recognized for its quality of teaching and research, with programs certified by the HRCES agency.
campus_student_life: The university has a 26-hectare campus located in the heart of Hanoi, making it one of the largest university campuses in the city. HUST provides accommodation in its dormitories, which can house over 4,000 students, and also assists students in finding off-campus housing. The campus features numerous laboratories for training and research, and student life is supported by various clubs and organizations.

name: Ho Chi Minh City International University
description: Ho Chi Minh City International University (HCMIU) is the first public research university in Vietnam offering programs entirely in English. Established in 2003, it is affiliated with Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City, and is recognized as a leading institution for academic and research excellence. HCMIU provides undergraduate and postgraduate programs in various fields, including business, engineering, and sciences.
campus_student_life: The university's main campus is located in Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City, covering 11.52 hectares. It features well-equipped facilities such as modern laboratories, lecture halls, and a library. Students have access to various services and can participate in diverse social activities and student organizations, contributing to a lively campus environment. Dormitory services are also available for students.

name: Ho Chi Minh City University of Agriculture and Forestry
description: Ho Chi Minh City University of Agriculture and Forestry (HCMUAF), also known as Nong Lam University, is a public research university established in 1955 in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It specializes in agriculture, forestry, environmental sciences, and related fields, and is known for its role in training professionals for sustainable agricultural and natural resource management. The university offers a wide range of undergraduate, master's, and doctoral programs across 12 faculties. [2, 5, 10]
campus_student_life: The main campus of HCMUAF is located in Thu Duc District, on the outskirts of Ho Chi Minh City, covering 118 hectares with a semi-rural setting. The university features over 60 specialized laboratories, 14 research and application centers, and the Research Institute for Biotechnology and Environment (RIBE). It also provides academic and non-academic facilities including a library, housing, and sports facilities, and participates in international exchange programs. [2, 5, 15]

name: Ho Chi Minh City University of Economics and Finance
description: Ho Chi Minh City University of Economics and Finance (UEF) is a private university established on September 24, 2007, in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It aims to be a leading university in Vietnam, achieving international academic standards in economics, finance, and related fields.
campus_student_life: UEF has two campuses located in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City. The main campus at 141-145 Dien Bien Phu features a 23-story building, while another campus at 276-282 Dien Bien Phu is a 16-story building. Facilities include modern classrooms, IT labs, a library, a self-studying area, and a fitness center.

name: Ho Chi Minh City University of Fine Arts
description: The Ho Chi Minh City University of Fine Arts (HCMUFA) is a public higher education institution in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, focused on training, research, and preservation of fine arts. It traces its origins to the Gia Dinh Drawing School founded in 1913 and is known for its programs in painting, graphics, sculpture, and design. The university serves as a leading center for artistic education in southern Vietnam.
campus_student_life: The university is located in Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City, on a compact urban campus that has evolved from its colonial-era origins. Key facilities include administrative halls, dedicated studio complexes for various art disciplines, and the Artspace Gallery for exhibitions. The central library houses a collection focused on Vietnamese and international art history, including rare colonial-era texts.

name: Ho Chi Minh City University of Foreign Languages and Information Technology
description: Ho Chi Minh City University of Foreign Languages and Information Technology (HUFLIT) is a private, multi-disciplinary higher education institution located in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It was initially founded in 1992 as the Saigon School of Foreign Languages and Information – Information Technology, and was upgraded and renamed HUFLIT in 1994. The university is known for educating and training professionals with strong foreign language and information technology skills, along with practical and professional expertise to meet market demands.
campus_student_life: HUFLIT operates four campuses, with three situated in the city center and one in Hoc Mon District, all equipped with modern facilities. These include specialized practice rooms such as a Moot Court Room and a Hotel & Tourism Practice Floor, as well as a gym, library, study areas, and sports courts. The university fosters a dynamic student life through various clubs, including English, Computer Science, Korean, Japanese, Futsal, and Basketball clubs, and organizes events for cultural exchange, academic advancement, and volunteering. While HUFLIT does not have on-campus dormitories, it assists international students in finding nearby accommodation.

name: Ho Chi Minh City University of Information Technology
description: The Ho Chi Minh City University of Information Technology (UIT) is a public university and a member of Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City. Established in 2006, it is a leading institution in Vietnam specializing in training and research in information and communication technology. UIT is known for its focus on high-quality human resource development and pioneering scientific research in IT-related fields.
campus_student_life: UIT has a suburban campus located in Ho Chi Minh City, with modern infrastructure including lecture halls, laboratories, and a library. The university provides a dormitory for students and offers various academic and non-academic facilities and services. Students have access to computer rooms, a banking activities simulation room, and sports facilities like a gymnasium, tennis court, and fields for football and badminton.

name: Ho Chi Minh City University of Law
description: Ho Chi Minh City University of Law (ULAW) is a public, non-profit higher education institution established in 1996. It is recognized as one of Vietnam's leading universities for legal education and training, playing a significant role in legal research and advisory for the government. The university offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in various law specializations.
campus_student_life: The university has multiple campuses in Ho Chi Minh City, including a main campus in District 4 which houses the administration, library, and student facilities. It features a comprehensive law library with a large collection of books and digital resources, and also provides academic and non-academic services for students. Student organizations and legal forums are supported to enhance professional development.

name: Ho Chi Minh City University of Science
description: The Ho Chi Minh City University of Science (HCMUS) is a public research university established in 1941, located in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It is a member of Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City, and focuses on science, technology, and interdisciplinary fields, aiming to be a leading institution in Southeast Asia for science education and research. The university offers undergraduate, master's, and doctoral degrees.
campus_student_life: HCMUS has an urban campus, providing students with proximity to the city's amenities and opportunities for internships and part-time jobs. The university provides facilities such as a library and sports facilities. It also engages in international exchange programs to foster global communication among students.

name: Ho Chi Minh City University of Social Sciences and Humanities
description: The Ho Chi Minh City University of Social Sciences and Humanities (HCMUSSH) is a public university and a member of Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City. Established in 1957, it is a leading institution in Vietnam for social sciences and humanities, known for offering specialized programs and conducting research in these fields. It is considered the largest training and research center for social sciences and humanities in Southern Vietnam.
campus_student_life: The university has a well-maintained and clean urban campus located in Ho Chi Minh City. It offers various academic and non-academic facilities, including a library with a diverse collection, sports grounds, and numerous student clubs and organizations. Student life is enriched by intercultural activities due to a diverse student body, including international students, and opportunities for engagement in extracurricular activities, internships, and community service.

name: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology
description: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HCMUT) is a public research university in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, established in 1957. It is a key member of Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City, and is known for its focus on high technology, engineering, and applied sciences. HCMUT is recognized for its international accreditations and commitment to research and innovation.
campus_student_life: HCMUT operates two campuses: a main campus in District 10 and a second campus in Di An City, Binh Duong Province. The university provides modern facilities for teaching and research, including libraries and laboratories. Student life includes various clubs and organizations, and the university offers support services and housing options.

name: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology and Education
description: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology and Education (HCMUTE) is a public university located in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, established in 1962. It is recognized as one of the top technical universities in Vietnam and is known for its focus on technical education, teacher training, and applied sciences. The university offers a wide range of undergraduate and graduate programs in fields such as engineering, technology, and education.
campus_student_life: The university is situated in Thủ Đức Ward, approximately 10 km northeast of downtown Ho Chi Minh City. HCMUTE provides students with academic and non-academic facilities, including a library, housing, sports facilities, and opportunities for study abroad programs. It also offers online courses and distance learning options.

name: Hoa Sen University
description: Hoa Sen University (HSU) is a private university located in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Established in 1991 as the School of Foreign Languages and Information Technology, it was officially upgraded to a university in 2006. HSU is known for its liberal education philosophy, international accreditations, and a dynamic learning environment deeply connected to real-world business practices.
campus_student_life: The university operates across multiple campuses in Ho Chi Minh City, including the Nguyen Van Trang Headquarters, Cao Thang, Thanh Thai, and Quang Trung campuses, all equipped with modern facilities such as libraries and computer labs. Student life is vibrant with over 30 diverse clubs covering academic, artistic, and sports interests, alongside numerous events and practical experience opportunities.

name: Hong Bang International University
description: Hong Bang International University (HIU) is a private, non-profit higher education institution founded in 1997 in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It offers a wide range of undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral programs across various fields, with a particular strength in Health Sciences. HIU is known for its commitment to international standards and applied research.
campus_student_life: HIU has two campuses in Ho Chi Minh City, featuring modern infrastructure including well-equipped classrooms, laboratories, and libraries. The university provides various academic and non-academic facilities and services, such as sports facilities, financial aid, study abroad programs, and administrative services. Student life is enriched by a variety of cultural, social, sporting, and recreational activities, including numerous student clubs and organizations.

name: Hung Vuong University
description: Hung Vuong University is a public, non-profit higher education institution located in Viet Tri, Phu Tho Province, Vietnam. Established in 2003, it was the first university in Phu Tho Province. The university is known for training highly qualified human resources, conducting scientific research, and transferring scientific advances to support the socio-economic development of Phu Tho province and the surrounding region.
campus_student_life: The university's main campus is situated in an urban setting in Viet Tri, with an additional branch campus in Phu Tho. Facilities include a library, lecture halls, modern classrooms, and specialized laboratories for fields such as engineering, information technology, pharmacy, and graphic design. Student housing is available in dormitories, which comprise two 4-story buildings with 86 rooms, accommodating nearly 700 students and offering amenities like bunk beds, fans, lockers, and a reading room. Student life is enriched by various clubs, including IT and Engineering Clubs, an English Speaking Club, and a Cultural Exchange Club.

name: Industrial University of Ho Chi Minh City
description: The Industrial University of Ho Chi Minh City (IUH) is a public university in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, established in its current form in 2004. It has a history dating back to 1956 as Go Vap Vocational School and is known for its applied orientation in education and training. IUH is recognized as one of the largest educational and training institutions in Vietnam.
campus_student_life: IUH has a main campus in Go Vap District, Ho Chi Minh City, and also a campus in Quang Ngai. The university provides accommodation for students in its dormitories, which can house nearly 20,000 students in shared rooms. Student life includes various clubs and organizations, and the university encourages international students to participate in extracurricular activities to experience Vietnamese culture.

name: Lac Hong University
description: Founded in 1997, Lac Hong University is a private higher education institution located in Bien Hoa, Dong Nai Province, Vietnam. It is recognized for its focus on applied sciences, technology, engineering, and notable achievements in robotics.
campus_student_life: The university has eight campuses, with seven in Tran Bien ward and one in Long Khanh ward, Dong Nai city. Facilities include libraries, computer rooms, Cisco labs, specialized resource rooms, laboratories, and robot workshops. A five-story dormitory on the third campus accommodates nearly 500 students, offering amenities like Wi-Fi, laundry, and a canteen, alongside various student clubs and events.

name: Manchester Metropolitan University
description: Manchester Metropolitan University is a public university located in Manchester, England, established in its current form in 1992, with predecessor institutions dating back to 1824. It offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs across four faculties: Arts and Humanities, Business and Law, Health and Education, and Science and Engineering. The university is recognized for its applied learning, strong industry partnerships, and a high graduate employment rate.
financials: VND 470m-780m ($20,000-21,500) for undergraduate taught courses, and VND 490m-530m ($21,000-22,500) for postgraduate taught courses.
campus_student_life: The university has multiple campuses in Manchester, including All Saints and Birley Fields, offering a blend of historical and modern architecture. Students have access to state-of-the-art facilities, including 24-hour libraries, sports centers, and eco-friendly accommodations. The Students' Union provides a platform for over 100 student clubs and organizations, and a variety of social events and activities.

name: National Academy of Public Administration (Vietnam)
description: The National Academy of Public Administration (NAPA) is a key national institution in Vietnam, established in 1959. It focuses on training and fostering public officials, civil servants, and state managers in public administration, leadership, and management. NAPA also conducts research and provides policy consultation for the Vietnamese government.
campus_student_life: NAPA has campuses in Hanoi, Hue, and Ho Chi Minh City. The academy offers a rigorous academic environment with a strong focus on public administration, governance, and policy studies. Student life includes participation in various clubs and societies, such as debate clubs and public policy groups, alongside opportunities for professional development.

name: National Economics University
description: The National Economics University (NEU) is a leading public research university in Hanoi, Vietnam, established in 1956. It is renowned for its programs in Economics, Public Administration, and Business Administration, and plays a significant role in policy consultation for the Vietnamese government. NEU is also a hub for academic exchange, with partnerships with over 100 institutions worldwide.
campus_student_life: NEU's campus in Hanoi is equipped with modern facilities, including over 120 lecture halls, a library spanning 3,405 square meters, a clinic, and a two-story cafeteria. For students, there are 6 dormitory buildings accommodating over 3,000 local students and 20 rooms for international students. The campus also features a sports complex with a mini-football field, volleyball court, basketball courts, and tennis courts, alongside numerous student clubs and cultural events that foster a dynamic community.

name: Nha Trang University
description: Nha Trang University, founded in 1959, is a public multidisciplinary higher education institution located in Nha Trang, Vietnam. It is particularly known for its strengths in marine science, technology, and fisheries, playing a key role in the development of Vietnam's marine economy.
financials: VND 4m-5m per semester ($160-200) for general programs, and VND 10m per semester ($400) for high-quality programs (2020-2021).
campus_student_life: The main campus of Nha Trang University is situated in a scenic coastal location in Nha Trang city, covering 20 hectares. The university provides extensive facilities including 10 dormitory buildings with accommodation for over 5,000 students, 50 laboratories, an 800-seat indoor stadium, and a library with a large collection of resources. Free Wi-Fi is available across campus.

name: Pham Ngoc Thach University of Medicine
description: Pham Ngoc Thach University of Medicine is a public medical university located in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Established in 1989 as a medical training center, it was officially recognized as a university in 2008. The institution is known for training healthcare professionals and its focus on practical clinical training and public health education.
campus_student_life: The university features a modern 2-hectare urban campus in District 10, Ho Chi Minh City, equipped with laboratories, lecture halls, and libraries. It is affiliated with several hospitals in Ho Chi Minh City, providing essential clinical training. On-campus dormitory options are limited, with students often seeking accommodation in nearby hostels and apartments.

name: Quảng Bình University
description: Quảng Bình University is a public, multidisciplinary higher education institution located in Đồng Hới city, Quảng Bình Province, Vietnam. Established on October 24, 2006, it aims to train high-quality human resources and conduct scientific research for the socio-economic development of the region.
campus_student_life: The university's 12-hectare campus is situated in Đồng Hới city and provides facilities such as libraries, laboratories, modern classrooms, dormitories, cafeterias, and sports areas. Students have opportunities to participate in various sports clubs.

name: Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology Vietnam
description: RMIT University Vietnam is the Vietnamese branch of the Australian university RMIT University, established in 2000. It is the first fully foreign-owned university in Vietnam and is known for its Australian-accredited education and English-language instruction. RMIT Vietnam has campuses in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi, and an English language centre in Danang.
campus_student_life: RMIT Vietnam has campuses in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi, with an English language centre in Danang. The university offers over 60 student clubs, covering a wide range of interests from photography and dance to entrepreneurship and business. Students have access to a global exchange program, allowing them to study at partner universities in over 45 countries.

name: Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology Vietnam
description: RMIT University Vietnam is the Vietnamese branch of Australia's RMIT University, established in 2000. It was the first fully foreign-owned university in Vietnam and offers programs in business, technology, communication, design, and languages. The university has campuses in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, and Danang.
campus_student_life: RMIT Vietnam has campuses in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi, with facilities including libraries, labs, and sports complexes. Student life is active with over 60 student clubs and organizations covering a wide range of interests, alongside various events and activities organized throughout the year. The university also offers accommodation options.

name: Saigon International University
description: Saigon International University (SIU) is a private, for-profit higher education institution established in 2007 in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It is known as Vietnam's first international private university, offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs taught in both English and Vietnamese, following American university curriculum standards. SIU's business programs are accredited by IACBE, and its Computer Science program by ABET.
campus_student_life: SIU features a modern urban campus in Ho Chi Minh City with multiple halls, including Lewis, Eliot, McCarthy, Fleming, and Dong A. The university provides a library with diverse resources and modern facilities, along with sports facilities, fostering a multicultural learning environment with various student clubs and organizations.

name: Saigon Technology University
description: Saigon Technology University (STU) is a private university located in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, established in 1997. It specializes in technology, engineering, and management fields, offering undergraduate and master's programs. STU is known for its focus on practical skills and innovation, preparing graduates for careers in technology and engineering.
campus_student_life: The university has two campuses in Ho Chi Minh City. Campus No. 2, located at 180 Cao Lo, District 8, is over 20,000 m2 and includes numerous classrooms, laboratories, a workshop, and a computer center. Campus No. 1, at 354 Ben Chuong Duong, District 1, is 6,500 m2 and features classrooms, labs, and a dormitory that can house approximately 200 students annually. The campus environment is designed to be conducive to learning, with green spaces and parking facilities.

name: Saigon University
description: Saigon University is a public higher education institution located in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Established on April 25, 2007, through the transformation of a Teacher Training College founded in 1976, it is dedicated to higher education and scientific research. The university offers a diverse range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs across various disciplines, aiming to train high-quality human resources for national development.
campus_student_life: Saigon University operates across multiple campuses in central Ho Chi Minh City, with its main headquarters in District 5 and additional sites in Districts 1 and 3. The university provides a dormitory at 99 An Dương Vương and fosters student engagement through its Youth Union and Student Union, which manage over 35 clubs covering academics, skills, hobbies, culture, arts, sports, and volunteering.

name: The University of Theatre and Cinema Ho Chi Minh City
description: The University of Theatre and Cinema Ho Chi Minh City is a public university in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, established in 2009. It provides higher education courses in performing arts and filmmaking. The institution is affiliated with and governed by Vietnam's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, and is often regarded as a leading film school in Vietnam.
campus_student_life: The university's urban campus spans 4,282.4 m2 (1.0582 acres) and is described as compact yet well-organized, fostering creativity and individual expression among students. Students engage in events and seminars with industry guest speakers, and the university hosts various film festivals. Facilities include a large library and a film screening room for practical experience and free movie viewing.

name: Tra Vinh University
description: Tra Vinh University is a public university established in 2006, located in Tra Vinh City, Vietnam. It originated from Tra Vinh Community College, founded in 2001 through a partnership between the Vietnamese and Canadian governments. The university focuses on providing education and skills relevant to the Mekong Delta region's workforce needs, with programs in agriculture, fisheries, engineering, health sciences, economics, and more.
campus_student_life: Tra Vinh University's campus is described as green, clean, and appealing, with modern facilities including lecture halls, libraries, laboratories, computer centers, dormitories, and sports complexes. Student life includes cultural diversity, with students from various ethnic backgrounds and international students participating in exchange activities. Extracurriculars such as sports, cultural clubs, and volunteer programs are available, along with support services like academic advising and career counseling.

name: University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City
description: The University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City (UEH) is a public research university established in 1976 in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It is a key national university known for its focus on economics, management, and business-related disciplines, and has been recognized as one of the top universities in Asia. UEH has evolved into a multidisciplinary university, aiming to foster global citizens for sustainable development.
campus_student_life: UEH operates across 13 campuses in Ho Chi Minh City and offers a vibrant campus experience with over 60 student clubs and societies. The university provides comprehensive student support services, including career counseling and mental health services, alongside modern dormitories, athletic facilities, and creative hubs.

name: University of Economics and Law
description: The University of Economics and Law (UEL) is a public university in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, operating under Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City. Established in 2010, it is known for its high-quality programs in economics, business, law, and management, with a focus on socio-economic development and global integration. UEL emphasizes the integration of theoretical knowledge with practical application and maintains strong links with businesses and government bodies.
campus_student_life: The university's campus is located in Ho Chi Minh City and spans 16.3 hectares. UEL provides a library for students and offers various athletic opportunities, including sports grounds and clubs. It also supports student well-being through counseling services and encourages participation in student organizations, ranging from academic to cultural and sports clubs.

name: University of London
description: The University of London is a federal university based in the United Kingdom that offers its globally recognised degrees through a network of local Recognised Teaching Centres in Vietnam. It provides academic direction, curricula, and assessment, ensuring the same academic standards as its UK colleges.
campus_student_life: The University of London itself does not operate a dedicated campus or provide student life facilities in Vietnam. These aspects are managed by its partner institutions, such as British University Vietnam (BUV), which has a campus in the Ecopark township designed to accommodate up to 2,000 students, with plans for expansion to 7,000.

name: University of Medicine and Pharmacy at Ho Chi Minh City
description: The University of Medicine and Pharmacy at Ho Chi Minh City (UMP) is a public, non-profit higher education institution founded in 1947. It is one of Vietnam's leading medical and pharmaceutical training centers, known for its rigorous academic standards and comprehensive programs. UMP is committed to research and innovation in healthcare.
campus_student_life: The university has multiple campuses located in Ho Chi Minh City, offering students access to a vibrant urban environment. It provides academic and non-academic facilities, including a library and sports grounds, and various student clubs. Clinical training takes place at its own teaching hospital and affiliated hospitals.

name: University of Science and Technology of Hanoi
description: The University of Science and Technology of Hanoi (USTH), also known as Vietnam-France University, is a public institution established in 2009 through an intergovernmental agreement between Vietnam and France. It is a research-oriented university with English as the primary language of instruction, aiming to meet international standards. USTH is supported by the Vietnam Academy of Science and Technology (VAST) and a consortium of French universities and research institutions.
campus_student_life: USTH's campus is located within the Vietnam Academy of Science and Technology (VAST) grounds, with plans for a larger campus in Hoa Lac High-tech Park. The current facilities include classrooms, laboratories, and administrative spaces, with ongoing development for a comprehensive campus featuring modern amenities. The university fosters a learning environment with access to research facilities and collaborative opportunities with VAST institutes.

name: University of Staffordshire
description: The University of Staffordshire is a public university in Staffordshire, England, with its main campus in Stoke-on-Trent and additional campuses in Stafford and London. It was founded in 1914 and gained university status in 1992. The university is known for its career-focused approach, strong industry connections, and innovative teaching methods, particularly in fields like games education.
campus_student_life: The university has three main campuses: Stoke-on-Trent, Stafford, and London. The Stoke-on-Trent campus is the largest and features facilities such as the Sir Stanley Matthews Sports Centre, a dedicated Science Centre, and a Games Hub. Student life is supported by a Students' Union offering over 70 societies and a variety of events. Guaranteed accommodation is available for first-choice students at the Stoke-on-Trent campus.

name: University of Stirling
description: The University of Stirling is a public university in Stirling, Scotland, founded in 1967. It is known for its pioneering approach to modular degrees and a two-semester structure, offering flexibility in study. The university has international degree partnerships, including one with British University Vietnam.
campus_student_life: The university's main campus is set within a 360-acre parkland estate, featuring a loch and an 18th-century castle. It offers a supportive environment with over 100 nationalities represented among its students. The Students' Union supports more than 90 clubs and societies, and the Sports Union supports 53 sports clubs.

name: VNU University of Economics and Business
description: VNU University of Economics and Business (VNU-UEB) is a public university in Hanoi, Vietnam, established in 2007 as a member of Vietnam National University, Hanoi. It is known for its programs in economics and business administration, with an emphasis on research and practical application. The university aims to contribute to Vietnam's socio-economic development through high-quality education and innovation.
financials: VND 46m-52m ($1800-$2050) per year for domestic students, and approximately $596 per year for international students for some programs.
campus_student_life: The university offers a vibrant academic and extracurricular environment with various student clubs and academic societies. Students have opportunities for internships and networking with businesses. VNU-UEB has dormitory facilities available on campus, such as the Ngoai ngu Dormitory, which can accommodate students from various VNU member institutions.

name: VNU University of Engineering and Technology
description: VNU University of Engineering and Technology is a non-profit public higher education institution located in the suburban area of Hanoi, Vietnam. Established in 2004, it is recognized as one of Vietnam's leading universities for Information Technology and Engineering, focusing on high-tech human resource development and research in various engineering and technology fields.
campus_student_life: The university provides academic and non-academic facilities, including a library. There are plans for a new campus in Thach Hoa Commune, Thach That District, Hanoi City, which will include lecture halls, libraries, sports areas, cafeterias, and dormitories. Student life is supported through various activities, exchange programs, scholarship opportunities, and career guidance.

name: VNU University of Languages and International Studies
description: VNU University of Languages and International Studies is a public institution and one of the nine member universities of Vietnam National University, Hanoi. Established on November 8, 1955, it is located at the VNU Cau Giay campus in Hanoi, Vietnam. The university is recognized as a leading national center for foreign language teacher and specialist education, offering undergraduate and graduate degrees in pedagogy and linguistic studies across various languages, and is known for its research in languages, linguistics, international studies, and related social sciences and humanities.
campus_student_life: The campus features over 200 lecture halls, classrooms, language labs, and a Learning Resource Center housing more than 54,000 foreign language books. It also includes a 1,000 square meter sports complex and student apartments capable of accommodating over 1,000 students on the main campus. Additionally, the university provides various student-run clubs covering sports, volunteering, dancing, culture, and language, and hosts international festivals.

name: VNU University of Science
description: VNU University of Science is a public university located in Hanoi, Vietnam, and is a member of Vietnam National University, Hanoi. While tracing its origins to Indochina University founded in 1906, the institution was established in its current form in 1995. It is recognized as a leading center for fundamental training and scientific research in natural sciences, technology, and environmental studies in Vietnam.
campus_student_life: The university operates across three urban campuses in Hanoi, with the main campus situated at 334 Nguyen Trai, Thanh Xuan. Notable facilities include 100 laboratories and computer labs dedicated to teaching, learning, and scientific research. Students have access to dormitories, such as the Me Tri Dormitory, and are encouraged to engage in scientific research.

name: VNU University of Social Sciences and Humanities
description: VNU University of Social Sciences and Humanities, established in 1945, is a prominent public research university in Hanoi, Vietnam, and a member of Vietnam National University, Hanoi. It is known for its comprehensive training and research in social sciences and humanities, contributing to national development and international integration.
campus_student_life: The university is located in Hanoi, Vietnam. It offers a dynamic academic environment with a wide network of collaborations with domestic and international universities, organizations, and businesses. Students have opportunities to participate in scientific research and internships.

name: Van Hien University
description: Van Hien University is a private, coeducational institution located in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, established in 1997. It offers a wide range of undergraduate, master's, and doctoral programs across various fields, including economics, tourism, technology, social sciences, and arts. The university emphasizes an applied-oriented approach to education, aiming to train high-quality human resources for society.
campus_student_life: The university has multiple campuses in Ho Chi Minh City, including a 60,000 square meter campus in Saigon South and a sports complex with six international standard football fields. Van Hien University supports over 32 student clubs and organizations, providing opportunities for extracurricular activities and personal development.

name: Van Lang University
description: Van Lang University is a private, non-profit higher education institution founded in 1995 in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs across various disciplines and is known for its focus on research, innovation, and practical skills development. The university aims to cultivate critical thinking and prepare students for successful careers and societal contributions.
campus_student_life: Van Lang University provides a vibrant campus life with over 80 student clubs catering to diverse interests, from arts and culture to sports and martial arts. The university emphasizes a holistic learning environment with modern facilities across its three campuses, including libraries, labs, and sports facilities. It also offers opportunities for international exchange programs and fosters a strong sense of community through various events and activities.

name: Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences
description: The Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences (VASS) is a state-run research institution under the Government of Vietnam, established in 1953. It is headquartered in Hanoi and serves as Vietnam's primary hub for social sciences and humanities research, offering policy advice to the government and providing postgraduate training. VASS is known for its extensive research on fundamental social science issues, contributing to national development strategies and policies.
campus_student_life: VASS's affiliated institutions are primarily located in Hanoi, with some branches in Ho Chi Minh City, Buon Ma Thuot, and Da Nang. The Academy manages numerous research institutes and non-research institutions, including the Graduate Academy of Social Sciences, the Vietnam Museum of Ethnology, and the Social Science Publishing House. The Social Sciences Library at VASS is a key resource, offering a rich collection of information in social sciences and humanities.

name: Vietnam Aviation Academy
description: The Vietnam Aviation Academy (VAA) is a public higher education institution established in 2006, specializing in aviation and aerospace education. It plays a crucial role in training and providing human resources for Vietnam's aviation industry. The academy has multiple campuses and offers a range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs in aviation-related fields.
campus_student_life: The academy has campuses in Ho Chi Minh City (Tân Bình District and Phú Nhuận District) and Cam Ranh, Khánh Hòa Province. It provides students with access to a library and digital resources. Student life includes various clubs, competitions, and enriching activities, fostering a vibrant campus experience.

name: Vietnam Maritime University
description: Vietnam Maritime University (VMU) is a public higher education institution located in Hai Phong, Vietnam, established on April 1, 1956. It is the only maritime university in Vietnam and is known for providing undergraduate and graduate education in shipbuilding, maritime navigation, and nautical technology. VMU aims to be a leading center for training and research in maritime and seaward economy fields in Asia.
campus_student_life: VMU has a main campus in Hai Phong and a second campus in Vung Tau city. The university provides various academic and non-academic facilities and services, including a library, study abroad programs, and administrative services. It is equipped with modern laboratory systems and advanced simulation and practical training facilities.

name: Vietnam National Academy of Music
description: The Vietnam National Academy of Music (VNAM), established in 1956, is the premier institution for music education in Vietnam, offering training in classical Western music and traditional Vietnamese music. Located in Hanoi, it provides comprehensive programs from secondary to doctoral levels, focusing on performance, research, and training. VNAM is known for its significant contributions to preserving Vietnamese musical heritage while integrating with the global music community.
campus_student_life: VNAM has a campus located at 77 Hào Nam Street, Hanoi. The academy is equipped with a concert hall that seats approximately 800 people and is noted for its good acoustics. It actively promotes student engagement through regular concerts, performances, and festivals, and fosters international collaboration through exchange programs and masterclasses with global music institutions.

name: Vietnam National University of Agriculture
description: Vietnam National University of Agriculture (VNUA) is a key national university specializing in agriculture and rural development, established on October 12, 1956. Located in Trau Quy town, Gia Lam district, Hanoi, it is a large, multi-disciplinary institution known for its human resource training and scientific research. VNUA offers a wide range of programs, including undergraduate, master's, and doctoral degrees, and has developed new training programs in various fields beyond traditional agriculture.
campus_student_life: The university is situated on a campus of nearly 200 hectares, featuring modern lecture halls, experimental facilities, spacious dormitories, a library system, and a large sports complex. VNUA provides numerous academic and non-academic services, including a library and administrative support. Students have many opportunities to participate in various activities such as clubs, sports, and student associations.

name: Vietnam University of Fine Arts
description: The Vietnam University of Fine Arts is a public art school located in Hanoi, Vietnam. Established in 1925 under French colonial rule as the Indochina School of Fine Arts, it is one of the oldest art institutions in Vietnam. The university is known for training many of Vietnam's leading artists and for its role in developing a distinctive Vietnamese style of modern art by integrating Western techniques with traditional Vietnamese media.
campus_student_life: The university is situated in Hanoi's Hoàn Kiếm District and features a Neo-Gothic architectural style. While described as having a small campus, it is noted for its lovely atmosphere in the heart of the city, offering a quiet and peaceful environment. It occasionally hosts exhibitions, attracting visitors to its premises.

name: Vietnamese-German University
description: The Vietnamese-German University (VGU) is a public university established in 2008 as a partnership between Vietnam and Germany, following German academic standards and models. It is known for its focus on engineering, natural sciences, and commerce, aiming to become a leading research university in Southeast Asia. VGU offers Bachelor's, Master's, and Doctoral programs, with degrees accredited by German partner universities.
campus_student_life: VGU's modern campus, which opened in 2023 in Binh Duong, Vietnam, features state-of-the-art facilities including engineering labs, a sports complex, and an events hall. The campus also includes research centers and accommodation for students. There are 21 active student clubs that contribute to the extracurricular environment.

name: Vinh University
description: Vinh University is a public, multidisciplinary university located in Vinh City, Nghe An Province, Vietnam. Established in 1959, it is a key national university in North Central Vietnam, focusing on teacher training, research, and policy consultation. It offers undergraduate, master's, and doctoral programs across a wide range of fields.
campus_student_life: Vinh University operates across five campuses with a total planned area of 130 hectares, with 44.12 hectares currently in use. The main campus includes administrative offices, classrooms, labs, a library, dormitories, and sports facilities. The university provides sports fields and training grounds for physical education and student activities. Campus canteens are available for dormitory students.
